customer: Got your offer on my EV, but I still owe more on the loan than that. Can I still sell it to you? Grad student budget here, so I want to know what I'd need to bring.
agent: Yes, you can still sell us the car. When the loan balance is higher than our offer (called negative equity, or being upside down), you pay the difference at the appointment, once we compare the offer with your payoff letter. For that payment we accept a cashier's check, a debit card or a personal check, but we can't accept credit cards. You can find more in our article "If you owe more than our offer."
